podcast.body: This novelty hit took the inaugural Best Rap Performance Grammy in 1989, which was the first year the category was introduced. However, the award was not televised, leading Jeff and Fresh Prince Will Smith to boycott the ceremony in protest. "DJ Jazee Jeff and the Fresh Prince's novelty hit Parents Just Don't Understand took the inaugural prize."
